title: For each of the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata
question: For each of the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries (only for non-deleted instances and only where the system metadata key is 'image_image_type'), show the display name, the metadata entry count, the overall average metadata entry count across these top 10 display names, and the deviation of each display name’s count from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_records
  FROM instances AS i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
  ORDER BY metadata_records DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records
  FROM top10
)
SELECT 
  t.display_name,
  t.metadata_records,
  a.avg_metadata_records,
  (t.metadata_records - a.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg
FROM top10 AS t
CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a
ORDER BY t.metadata_records DESC

  JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
  ORDER BY metadata_records DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records
  FROM top10
)
SELECT 
  t.display_name,
  t.metadata_records,
  a.avg_metadata_records,
  (t.metadata_records - a.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg
FROM top10 AS t
CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a
ORDER BY t.metadata_records DESC
